_comment: Platform defaults for the four conversational model policies compiled into a Business Pack. A project overrides any of them under ai.policyOverrides.<policyId> ({ provider?, model?, timeoutMs? }); nothing else about a policy is tenant-editable in simple mode. 'temperature' is 'zero' (deterministic steps) or 'configured' (the project's own setting).

policies.description: Fast intent and slot extraction policy for {projectId}
Tool and capability selection policy for {projectId}
Grounded customer response composition policy for {projectId}
